name: eFront Investment Café

web.notes: Hosted browser portal, deployed per GP or administrator, so investors meet many separate instances. SSO and MFA not stated.

api.notes: Press material cites API capabilities for sync with the eFront back office. No public docs. Also distributed by Apex Group.

notes: BlackRock-owned since 2019. Widely used by European GPs and administrators, including Aztec Group for its investor reporting portal. 56m+ documents shared with investors per vendor. No LP-side programmatic access identified. See registry/deployments.json for known deployments.
